Likely an OCR misread of the real total; voting/fallback did not reject an implausible candidate.","evidence":"field_feedback entry for 074.jpg: amount_correct=false; prediction row shows total_amount='702.00'"},{"id":"OF2","description":"077.jpg total_amount wrong (predicted 23.26 but marked amount_correct=false). Receipt shows 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' then 'Rounding Adj: -0.01' and final 'TOTAL: 23.25'. Agent picked the pre-rounding inclusive line.","evidence":"image 077.jpg shows TOTAL: 23.25 as last/rounded total; prediction='23.26'; feedback amount_correct=false"},{"id":"OF3","description":"078.jpg total_amount is empty string '' instead of real null; also the correct total 92.80 (Grand Total on 078) was not recovered. Trace shows candidates collapsed to None after header-exclusion fix, and final written value became '' not None.","evidence":"predictions row 078.jpg total_amount=''; timeline a0069 shows total=None but xlsx row ends up with empty string; image 078.jpg shows 'Grand Total 92.80'"},{"id":"OF4","description":"034.jpg date is wrong (date_correct=false, predicted 2018-08-09). Receipt text shows 'Date: 09/03/2018' (DD/MM/YYYY => 2018-03-09); extractor misparsed as MM/DD or picked another date token.","evidence":"image 034.jpg shows Date: 09/03/2018; prediction date='2018-08-09'; field_feedback date_correct=false"},{"id":"OF5","description":"Iteration budget exhausted before final verification/write of the schema-correct xlsx. Run terminated with stop_reason=max_iterations after 65 iterations, mid-debugging 078.","evidence":"execution_metadata.termination_reason='max_iterations'; acp_stop_reason='max_turn_requests'; a0074 agent_iteration_outcome"},{"id":"OF6","description":"Original agent did not use vision/multimodal input even though openai-vision skill was available; all extraction relied on Tesseract passes. Hard cases (faded 078, cluttered 074, rounded 077) could have been resolved by a vision fallback.","evidence":"response_tool_call_counts shows terminal/think/file_editor only; n_skill_invocations=0; openai-vision skill present in bundle"}],"root_causes":[{"id":"RC1","description":"Total-selection logic does not prefer the FINAL rounded/net total line when a receipt lists both an inclusive/pre-rounding total and a later 'Total Rounded' / 'Rounding Adj' / final 'TOTAL' line. Priority tiers treat 'TOTAL (Inclusive of GST)' and final 'TOTAL' with equal weight, so the first-matched (earlier) line wins and rounding adjustments are ignored. This is a general-purpose gap, not 077-specific.","related_failures":["OF2"]},{"id":"RC2","description":"Date extraction in the original skill has no disambiguation between DD/MM/YYYY and MM/DD/YYYY and no locale hint; it accepts the first regex match it finds. For Malaysian/SG-style receipts (DD/MM/YYYY dominant) this silently flips month/day for ambiguous dates (e.g., 09/03/2018).","related_failures":["OF4"]},{"id":"RC3","description":"Null handling in the xlsx writer path emits an empty string '' instead of real None/NA for missing total_amount. The strict-schema grader treats '' and real null differently; this is a general delivery-contract bug, not a per-receipt issue.","related_failures":["OF3"]},{"id":"RC4","description":"The OCR preprocessing variant set is too narrow for small/faded receipts: only default + grayscale+autocontrast at --psm 6 + 2x upscale at --psm 6. Receipt 078 requires 3x upscale + --psm 4 to recover 'Grand Total 92.80'; receipt 074 likely needs a different variant to avoid the 702.00 misread. The skill does not prescribe an upscale ladder (1.5x/2x/3x) nor a cross-variant voting rule that penalizes a candidate seen in only one noisy variant.","related_failures":["OF1","OF3"]},{"id":"RC5","description":"No sanity/plausibility check on the selected amount versus item-line amounts on the same receipt. A grand total should normally be >= max(line amount) and <= sum(line amounts) * (1 + tax_cap). 702.00 on 074.jpg could have been rejected against the visible item lines (if detectable) or against a 'Total Rounded' line elsewhere.","related_failures":["OF1"]},{"id":"RC6","description":"The skill bundle does not instruct the agent to use openai-vision as a fallback when Tesseract confidence is low or when multiple passes disagree. The agent therefore burns iterations retrying preprocessing variants and runs out of budget instead of escalating to vision.","related_failures":["OF5","OF6","OF3"]},{"id":"RC7","description":"Column-header exclusion was added ad-hoc for 'Description Qty Price Amount' but there is no general rule: 'any line that matches TOTAL/AMOUNT keywords but contains no digit and whose next line is an item row (qty + unit price + amount) is a header, not a label.' The original skill's TOTAL_PRIORITY pattern is prone to triggering on column headers on receipts with 'Amount' as a column.","related_failures":["OF1","OF3"]}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"TOTAL_PRIORITY tiering does not model 'final rounded total' vs 'inclusive-of-tax total' vs 'subtotal'. Needs an explicit highest tier for 'TOTAL ROUNDED', 'TOTAL AFTER ROUNDING', 'ROUNDED TOTAL', 'NET TOTAL', 'GRAND TOTAL', and a rule: when a receipt contains both an 'inclusive' total line AND a later 'TOTAL' / 'TOTAL ROUNDED' / 'Rounding Adj' block, prefer the later line.","evidence":"OF2 on 077.jpg; current skill lists GRAND TOTAL / TOTAL RM / TOTAL AMOUNT / TOTAL/AMOUNT tiers but no rounding-aware tier"},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction orders formats arbitrarily and returns the first match, with no locale hint. For receipts, DD/MM/YYYY should be tried before MM/DD/YYYY, and when both parse successfully for the same token, the DD/MM interpretation should win unless day>12.","evidence":"OF4 on 034.jpg (09/03/2018 → 2018-08-09 is impossible from that token directly, implying a different date line was picked; still indicates format-priority/locale is underspecified)"},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Multi-pass OCR pipeline underspecified: only lists 'try variants + PSM modes' in prose. Needs a concrete, deterministic ladder (grayscale+autocontrast → 1.5x → 2x → 3x upscales; PSM 6, 4, 11) AND a cross-variant majority/consistency rule so single-variant hallucinations (likely the source of 702.00 on 074 and 20.00 on 078) are suppressed.","evidence":"OF1, OF3; timeline shows agent manually discovered that 3x + PSM 4 recovers 92.80 on 078"},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No explicit rule about rejecting candidates on column-header lines (Description|Item|Qty|Price|Amount together with no numeric value on the same line). The ad-hoc fix the agent added mid-run belongs in the skill.","evidence":"OF3 trace in a0067/a0068"},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"Strict-schema writer guidance exists but is not enforced: the written xlsx row for 078.jpg contains '' (empty string) rather than real None for total_amount. The skill should mandate converting None/NaN to actual empty cell via openpyxl (cell.value = None) OR via pandas with astype(object).where(notna, None), and should include a self-check that asserts dtype object and no '' values.","evidence":"predictions row 078.jpg total_amount=''; xlsx skill already has a canonical pattern but the source agent did not follow it"},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"No post-write verifier step is required. The xlsx skill should mandate re-reading the file and asserting (a) sheet name exactly 'results', (b) column order, (c) total_amount values are str with two decimals or None, (d) filename column is lexicographically sorted.","evidence":"Delivery valid but field accuracy only 0.909; some issues would have been caught by a post-write assertion loop"},{"skill":"openai-vision","defect":"Skill does not describe a receipt-field-extraction fallback pattern (date + total_amount JSON schema) to be invoked when Tesseract passes disagree or return no candidate. Adding a short 'Use as Tesseract fallback for receipts' section would let the agent escalate instead of exhausting iterations.","evidence":"OF5, OF6; n_skill_invocations=0 in source run despite openai-vision being loaded"},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No guidance on handling two-line amount patterns like 'Total RM' followed by a numeric line (already partially covered) AND on handling 'Rounding Adj' adjustments: skill should instruct, when a 'Rounding Adj' line appears between the inclusive total and a subsequent 'TOTAL'/'Total Rounded' line, to take the later rounded value.","evidence":"OF2 on 077.jpg"}],"repair_recommendations":[{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Restructure TOTAL_PRIORITY into 5 tiers, from most to least specific: (T0) GRAND TOTAL, TOTAL ROUNDED, TOTAL AFTER ROUNDING, ROUNDED TOTAL, NET(T) TOTAL; (T1) TOTAL RM, TOTAL: RM, TOTAL (INCLUSIVE OF GST), TOTAL INCL GST, TOTAL SALES INCL GST; (T2) TOTAL AMOUNT; (T3) TOTAL DUE, AMOUNT DUE, BALANCE DUE; (T4) bare TOTAL / AMOUNT. Add an explicit rule: if both a T1 line and a later T0 line (or a 'Rounding Adj' line followed by a TOTAL line) exist, select the later rounded value. Document that ordering within a tier is 'latest occurrence wins' when 'Rounding Adj' is present on the receipt.","rationale":"Fixes OF2 generically; addresses RC1 and RC7. Generalizes beyond 077 by handling any 'inclusive + rounding + final total' layout."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand EXCLUSIONS to include generic column-header heuristics: skip any line that (a) matches a TOTAL/AMOUNT keyword, (b) contains zero digit characters, AND (c) also contains at least one of {DESCRIPTION, ITEM, QTY, QUANTITY, PRICE, U.PRICE, U/P, RSP, UNIT} on the same line. Also add 'ITEM COUNT', 'TOTAL QTY', 'TOT QTY', 'TOTAL SAVINGS', 'TOTAL ITEMS'.","rationale":"Removes the 'Description Qty Price Amount' and similar header-row false positives generically; addresses RC7 / OF3."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a documented deterministic multi-pass ladder: variants = [default; grayscale+autocontrast; grayscale+autocontrast+1.5x; grayscale+autocontrast+2x; grayscale+autocontrast+3x; inverted autocontrast] × PSM ∈ {6, 4, 11}. Collect candidate (keyword_tier, value) tuples from every variant. Select by: (1) highest tier T0 wins; (2) within tier, the value that appears in the most variants wins; (3) tie-break by proximity to the end of the receipt (later line wins). Document that a candidate appearing in only one variant with no agreement from any other variant must not be selected unless no other candidate exists.","rationale":"Prevents one-off OCR hallucinations like 702.00 on 074 and 20.00 on 078 from winning; addresses RC4, OF1, OF3. Ladder and voting rule generalize to any receipt."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Specify date-parse order and locale policy explicitly: try formats in this order and keep the FIRST successful parse per candidate token — %d/%m/%Y, %d-%m-%Y, %d %b %Y, %d-%b-%Y, %Y-%m-%d, %Y/%m/%d, %d/%m/%y. If a token successfully parses as both %d/%m/%Y and %m/%d/%Y, prefer %d/%m/%Y unless the day field would be >12 and the month field would be ≤12. Prefer candidates that appear after a 'Date' / 'Tarikh' / 'Invoice Date' / 'Receipt Date' label over bare matches. Ignore tokens inside 'GST', 'Tel', phone, invoice-number contexts.","rationale":"Fixes OF4 generically and prevents MM/DD vs DD/MM flips on international receipts; addresses RC2."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a plausibility check: after selecting a candidate total, if the receipt text contains any line-item amount pattern '<qty> x <unit_price> <amount>' or ' <amount>$' columns, compute max_item_amount and sum_item_amount; reject the candidate if candidate < max_item_amount or candidate > 10 × sum_item_amount. If rejected, fall back to the next-best candidate from the voting pool; if none, return None.","rationale":"Would have caught 702.00 on 074; addresses RC5 / OF1. Generalizes as a universal sanity check."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Document and mandate the per-image null-safe return contract: on any exception OR when no candidate survives voting/plausibility, return {'date': None, 'total_amount': None} — never '', 'None', 'NaN'. Add an explicit code checklist item to the Quality Self-Check section.","rationale":"Reinforces RC3 at the extraction layer; complements the xlsx-side fix for OF3."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a mandatory post-write verification block after writing stat_ocr.xlsx (or any strict-schema file): re-read with pd.read_excel(sheet_name=None); assert exactly one sheet named 'results'; assert columns ['filename','date','total_amount']; assert row order equals sorted(filenames); for every non-null total_amount assert isinstance(v,str) and re.fullmatch(r'\\d+\\.\\d{2}', v); for every null cell assert pd.isna(v) and not isinstance(v,str). On failure, rewrite with the canonical pattern (object dtype, None for missing).","rationale":"Would have caught the '' total_amount in 078.jpg; addresses RC3 / OF3 and hardens all strict-schema runs."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"In the Strict-Schema Outputs section, add a one-paragraph explicit warning: 'If you accumulate rows from a batch loop, store missing values as Python None (not empty string, not NaN). Before to_excel, run df = df.astype(object).where(df.notna(), None) so pandas writes true empty cells.' Include a two-line code snippet.","rationale":"Prevents the common empty-string footgun; generalizes to any strict-schema task."},{"target_skill":"openai-vision","change":"Add a short 'Receipt field extraction (Tesseract fallback)' section with a prompt template that asks GPT-4o-vision to return {'date': 'YYYY-MM-DD'|null, 'total_amount': 'N.NN'|null}, with instructions to prefer 'Grand Total' / 'Total Rounded' / 'Net Total' lines and ignore Subtotal/Tax/GST/Change/Cash Tendered. Document the recommended invocation policy: call this fallback when (a) Tesseract passes disagree across the voting ladder, (b) no candidate survives plausibility check, or (c) total_amount would otherwise be None but date is present (and vice versa).","rationale":"Gives the agent a documented escalation path instead of burning iterations on preprocessing; addresses RC6, OF5, OF6, and likely improves 074/077/078 jointly."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add explicit two-line-fallback refinement: when a TOTAL-tier keyword line has digits but no valid 'N.NN' token (e.g., '92:80', '92 80', '9280'), attempt (i) ':' → '.' repair, (ii) insert decimal before last two digits if the line's number has ≥3 digits and no decimal, (iii) remove internal spaces between digits; validate the repaired number against the plausibility check before accepting.","rationale":"Would recover 92.80 on 078 from 'a Total — 92:80' without needing vision fallback; addresses OF3 generically for OCR colon/space corruption."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a Quality Self-Check item: 'Prefer the latest TOTAL-tier line on the receipt when multiple candidates share the top tier; receipts commonly list Subtotal → Total (Inclusive) → Rounding Adj → Total Rounded, and the last line is authoritative.'","rationale":"Codifies the heuristic needed for 077 and similar receipts; reinforces RC1."}],"confidence":{"overall":"medium-high","observed_failures":"high — derived directly from field_feedback and image inspection","root_causes":"medium-high — inferred from timeline trace plus source skill text; RC1/RC2/RC3/RC4 are well-supported; RC5 is a design recommendation, not a proven cause for 074 (734/702 confusion could also be a pure OCR glitch)","skill_defects":"high — defects are concrete gaps against the task's specification","repair_recommendations":"medium-high — all recommendations stay within the five existing SKILL.md files and generalize beyond these 22 receipts; effectiveness depends on the agent actually invoking openai-vision as fallback"}}
